positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed large scale backend services that prevent and mitigate abuse from bad actors
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · Python (Programming Language) · Spring Boot · Amazon Web Services (AWS)

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
•	Worked as the primary developer on used car valuation.
o	Previously only worked for “older” cars (car that existed in previous old tech stack) in just the US.
o	Expanded to include “newer cars” (new stack including Model 3) and all other countries/markets.
o	Built UI (Django) to allow business users to configure pricing rules for model and country.
o	Created API endpoints that the used car listing service would call for prices.

positions.title: Software Intern
positions.description:
Worked as a developer in a team in the Energy Digital Products department.
New features and bug fixes on tesla.com using React/Redux.
Data pipelines and machine learning models to predict household energy consumption with 99% accuracy and assign to customers a solar propensity -- used this to target customers, increasing lead conversion rate from 10% to 50%.
Doubled utility bill calculator customer coverage to 68% by setting up a data pipeline utilizing Powerguide API, then analyzed discrepancies and implemented new utility rate plans with C# and .NET.

positions.title: Software Test Automation Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Optimized and redesigned over 900 test cases to ~300 test cases -- streamlining testing and reducing redundancy  
Replaced ~300 manual test cases with automated ones using the Selenium WebDriver API -- potentially saving hours of weekly testing
Wrote new test cases for new features of OpenStax website and Tutor technology
Bug reports and product testing

positions.title: Instructor
positions.description: Taught mathematics to students ranging from the ages of 8-20

honors.title: HackRice Challenge Winner
honors.description: ByPatient was the winner of the HackRice challenge: Facilitating interactions between doctors and patients.

projects.title: Empowered Patient
projects.description: Application to provide (very) case specific questions for patients to ask their physician, tailored to their exact situation using experienced practitioner guidance.

projects.title: ByPatient
projects.description: (HackRice 2017) An interactive app to promote patient self-care. Using Twilio API, texted information of the drugs (instructions, effects, side-effects, dangers, etc.) to the patient, their current diagnosis, as well as reminding them to take their medication.
